lessons.trigger_condition: a scheduled collector publishes directly to protected main or a one-shot finalizer runs current-runtime tests without repository dependencies
lessons.symptom_summary: protected-main publication fails or final verification reports import errors instead of validating the exact final tree
lessons.fix_pattern: publish through an exact-SHA candidate PR, install the repository requirements in the finalizer, remove the finalizer from the final tree, and require protected checks before merge

lessons.trigger_condition: a temporary workflow removes itself after tests and changes the tracked final tree
lessons.symptom_summary: the branch can be logically complete while the integrity manifest still represents the pre-finalization tree
lessons.fix_pattern: remove the temporary workflow first, regenerate and diagnose the manifest from the final tree, then rerun integrity and current-runtime validation

lessons.trigger_condition: the tablet supervisor computes a generic interval instead of the next exact local 23:00 update window
lessons.symptom_summary: feature and code refreshes can run at unintended times or more often than requested
lessons.fix_pattern: keep Termux Boot supervision but calculate one exact next 23:00 KST feature update and preserve existing fail-closed update gates

lessons.trigger_condition: successful package uploads and tablet receipts accumulate indefinitely in the TCG-managed Drive paths
lessons.symptom_summary: Drive usage grows while stale packages and receipts remain available beyond their useful recovery window
lessons.fix_pattern: after upload and read-back verification, delete only recognized TCG-managed objects using 14-day retention with minimum and maximum keep bounds while preserving unknown user files
